preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if (N := int(line.split()[0])) is not None)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N must be an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= N for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if (K := int(line.split()[1])) is not None and (N := int(line.split()[0])) is not None)
preconditions.description: For each test case, K must be an integer between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == N for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip() != '-1')
postconditions.description: Each output line (except -1) must contain exactly N integers representing a permutation of length N.

postconditions.expression: all(set(output_line.split()) == set(range(1, N + 1)) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip() != '-1' and (N := len(output_line.split())) > 0)
postconditions.description: Each output line (except -1) must be a permutation of the integers from 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for i in range(1, N + 1) if (P := [int(x) for x in output_line.split()])[i - 1] % i == 0) == K for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip() != '-1' and (N := len(output_line.split())) > 0 and (K := int(input_line.split()[1])) is not None and (input_line := next((line for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == str(N)), None)) is not None)
postconditions.description: For each output line (except -1), the number of good indices (where P[i] is divisible by i) must equal K.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line.strip() == '-1' or (len(output_line.split()) == N and all(1 <= int(x) <= N for x in output_line.split())) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if (N := int(next((line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == output_line.split()[0]), None))) is not None)
postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, the output line must be -1.
